primary: Correct numerical answer against original FinQA exe_ans, absolute tolerance 0.00005, all planned tasks in denominator.
source: 40 selected test pages from FinQA: 38 company-year reports, 28 companies; fixed eligibility and hash ordering. Restricted table-only subset.
controls: Same schema, question, interpreter, model and numeric evaluator. eager_allowed sends all numeric cells. requested_cells lets the model request up to 12 cells once and restricts computation to those cells. local_program sends no numeric cell values and executes the returned bounded expression locally. All final answers are assembled locally.
development: Three development-split cases used for smoke testing. The first pilot exposed ratio/sign convention errors; one uniform instruction was added for all methods before test freeze. No test model outputs observed before freeze.
secondary: unique and cumulative raw numeric cells transmitted
cells outside original gold program (not semantic privacy)
inference: Aggregate repeats within case; paired cluster bootstrap by company-year report, 4000 draws. Descriptive uncertainty for this selected subset; no general-population or non-inferiority claim.
failures: No model-result based selection or relabeling. Provider/parse/program errors remain failures. Resume only absent job IDs. No best-of selection.
scope: No human text-quality score, cryptographic privacy, semantic non-disclosure, data-minimization optimality, or external-system superiority claim.
